hackathons.fullDescription:
HAXFINITY — Hack the Infinite

The 24-hour hackathon of XTHRON '26

 December 2026
Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur, Kerala
Prize Pool: Exciting prizes
Team Size: 2–4 participants

Build real solutions. Solve meaningful problems. Create something that works.

HAXFINITY is the 24-hour hackathon conducted as part of XTHRON '26, the annual IT fest of the Department of Computer Science, Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur.

For 24 hours, students from different colleges and backgrounds will come together to identify problems, develop  software solutions, build working prototypes, and present their ideas to a panel of judges.

There is no compulsory theme. Participants are free to choose a problem and develop a software solution using any suitable technology.

Whether you are an experienced developer or participating in your first hackathon, HAXFINITY is a space to learn, collaborate, experiment, and build.

PRIZE POOL — Exciting prizes


TRACKS

OPEN INNOVATION

Build anything that solves a real problem.

You may work in education, healthcare, finance, agriculture, entertainment, productivity, cybersecurity, accessibility, sustainability, or any other domain.

There is no fixed problem statement and no restriction on technology. Choose a problem, design a solution, build a working prototype, and surprise the judges.

AI / ML

Build intelligent systems using machine learning, generative AI, natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems, data analysis, or any other AI-related technology.

Projects will be evaluated on technical implementation, originality, usefulness, and real-world applicability.

SOCIAL GOOD

Build technology that improves people’s lives.

Possible areas include rural development, accessibility, mental health, financial inclusion, education, healthcare, environmental protection, and community welfare.

Projects in this track will be evaluated on impact, usability, sustainability, and the effectiveness of the proposed solution.

WHAT THE HACKATHON LOOKS LIKE

16 December, 10:30 AM — Opening ceremony and problem-solving begins.

During the day — Teams form, ideas take shape, and development begins.

Throughout the event — Mentoring, technical support, checkpoints, and interaction with fellow participants.

Midnight — The hackathon continues with snacks, discussions, debugging, and late-night building.

17 December, 10:32 AM — Submission deadline and code freeze.

After submission — Teams prepare their final demonstrations.

Final judging — Each team presents its working prototype to the judges.

Closing ceremony — Winners are announced and prizes are distributed.

WHO CAN PARTICIPATE?

HAXFINITY is open to students from all streams and colleges.

Students from computer science, information technology, engineering, science, commerce, management, design, and other disciplines are welcome.

You may participate if you are:

- A beginner attending your first hackathon.
- An experienced developer.
- A designer or creative problem-solver.
- A student interested in AI, cybersecurity, cloud, web, mobile, or social-impact technology.
- Someone with an idea and the willingness to build it.

The only requirement is that you come prepared to learn, collaborate, and create.

TEAM DETAILS

- Each team must have 2–4 participants.
- Solo participation is not permitted.
- Participants from different colleges may form one team.
- Participants from different academic streams may form one team.
- Interdisciplinary teams are encouraged.
- Each participant may be part of only one team.

WHERE IT HAPPENS

Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous)
Santhigramam, Eranhimangad
Nilambur, Malappuram, Kerala — 679329

The campus is located in the Nilambur region of Kerala, known for its natural surroundings and teak forests.

The college is approximately:

- 3 km from Nilambur Railway Station.
- 1 km from the Calicut–Nilambur–Ooty highway.

Travel and accommodation information will be shared with registered participants.

WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Dedicated workspace for participating teams.
- Power and internet access.
- Lunch on the first day.
- Dinner on the first day.
- Breakfast on the second day.
- Midnight snacks.
- Technical assistance during the event.
- Mentoring and guidance, subject to mentor availability.
- Certificates for participants.
- A platform to demonstrate projects to judges and fellow innovators.

Cloud credits, software benefits, and additional resources may be announced later if they are officially confirmed.

RULES

- Teams must contain 2–4 participants.
- The project must be developed during the official hackathon period.
- Participants may use open-source libraries, frameworks, APIs, and publicly available datasets.
- Previously developed projects may not be submitted as new work.
- Teams must clearly disclose any pre-existing code, templates, datasets, APIs, or third-party services used.
- Projects must be submitted through Devfolio before the deadline.
- Late submissions may not be accepted.
- A working prototype or meaningful demonstration is expected.
- Teams must be prepared to explain their technology, development process, and contribution.
- Projects must not violate copyright, privacy, security, or applicable law.
- All participants must follow the event Code of Conduct.
- The organisers reserve the right to reject projects that are unsafe, copied, offensive, illegal, or unrelated to the event.
- The detailed judging criteria and final rules will be published before the event.




HAXFINITY — Hack the Infinite
EXTHRONE ’26
12–13 December 2026

hackathons.fullDescription:
# 🚀 Hacknauts 2.0

### 🌌 Beyond the Known, Begins the Extraordinary

**Hacknauts 2.0 (HKN-26)** is a 24-hour hackathon at **Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Ludhiana**, organized by the **Causmic Club**. 🚀

After a successful first mission, we're back in orbit. 🛰️ This year, everything revolves around one idea: **a black hole pulling streams of code into itself. 🕳️**

The brightest builders, designers, and problem-solvers converge for one weekend - to ideate, build, and ship something that didn't exist before. 💻✨

**One mission. One singularity. Your code, pulled toward something bigger. 🌠**

---

### 🌌 What Awaits You

* ⏱️ **24 hours** of building, mentorship, and midnight debugging
* 🛰️ **Multiple mission tracks** — revealed soon
* 🍕 **Free food, beverages, and high-speed internet** for all participants
* 🎁 **Swag and goodies** in every participant kit
* 🏅 **Certificates for every team + prizes** across tracks
* 🏆 **Best Freshers Team** — a special award for the best-performing team consisting of first-year students
* 👩‍🚀 **Best Girls Team** — a special award for the best-performing all-girls team
* 🤝 **A crew of like-minded builders** — and recruiters watching the launch pad

---

### 📍 Event Info

* 📅 **Date:** November 14–15, 2026
* 🏫 **Venue:** Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College, Gill Park, Ludhiana — 141006
* 👥 **Team Size:** 2–4 members
* 🧑‍💻 **Mode:** In-person
* 🪐 **Mission Code:** HKN-26 — every transmission carries it

---

### 📝 Registrations

* 🚀 **Process:** Apply right here on Devfolio

* 💬 **Join the WhatsApp & Discord for updates**

**[WhatsApp](https://chat.whatsapp.com/EDvb3mBBEZQKKEBKEZCijD)**

**[Discord](https://discord.gg/fBpkNWM7d)**

---

### 📊 PPT Submission

All participating teams are required to submit their **project presentation (PPT)** before the deadline.

🎨 **[PPT Template](https://canva.link/btilhjpotmmporm)**

📤 **[Submit Your PPT](https://tally.so/r/pb2Xo1)**

⏰ **Submission Deadline:** **30 October 2026**

Make sure your presentation follows the provided template and is submitted before the deadline. 🚀

---

### 🌠 Your Mission Awaits

Build boldly. Think beyond the obvious. Solve something that matters.

**The singularity is waiting. What will you pull into orbit? 🕳️🚀**

**Hacknauts 2.0 - Beyond the Known, Begins the Extraordinary.**
